notes: Fastned "Model 3 Long Range (2019 - 2023)" curve, measured on a European CCS2 300 kW charger (market EU/CCS2), battery around 30 C, 11-90 % SoC, peak 195.1 kW at 38 %. EU CCS2; NA Supercharger early peak ~250 kW, so the early plateau is understated by up to ~25 % for a North American car (InsideEVs, 2021 LR AWD on a V3 Supercharger: 249-250 kW peak, 94-106 kW 20-80 % average; Fastned curve time-weighted 20-80 % average about 126 kW, InsideEVs quotes 128 kW for the Fastned 2019-20 LR AWD at 195 kW peak). Applies to the 78.8 kWh Panasonic NCA Long Range/Performance cars; the Performance sharing this pack and software is assumed, not sourced. Fastned's label starts at 2019: the 2017-2018 cars had earlier charging software, so the match is unproven.
